The following events took place in '''3678 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Exal Kressh]], the apprentice of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], betrays the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and is hunted down and finally killed on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]].<ref name="Shades of the Sith">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref><ref name="Broken World">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 2: The Broken World]]''</ref><ref name="Burn the Future">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 3: Burn the Future]]''</ref>
